invention.ref_zh: 目前较坚实的中国证据：长沙一带约公元302年陶俑出现马镫状装置

popularization.ref: Paired riding stirrups spread across East Asian and steppe cavalry cultures
popularization.ref_zh: 双马镫在东亚与草原骑兵文化中扩散

locations.place_label_zh: 蒙古阿尔泰一带（早期马具发现）

sources.title: Origins of saddles and riding technology in East Asia — Antiquity
Further discussion on the origins of horse stirrups

notes: 真正双马镫的起源长期存在「中国说」与「草原说」。中国长沙一带约公元302年的陶俑证据较早且常被引用；蒙古等地四至五世纪马具发现则显示东亚—草原可能共同发展。单侧上马镫与真正成对骑乘镫也需区分，故标为争议。
notes_en: True paired stirrups are long disputed between China-centred and steppe-centred accounts. A Changsha-area figurine of about 302 CE is an early firm Chinese marker; Mongolian finds of the 4th–5th centuries suggest shared East Asian–steppe development. Single mounting loops also differ from paired riding stirrups.
summary_zh: 马镫约四世纪初出现于东亚；中国长沙一带约公元302年已有相关陶俑证据，与草原马具传统的先后关系仍有争议。
summary_en: Stirrups appear in East Asia by the early 4th century. A Changsha-area figurine of about 302 CE is early Chinese evidence; priority versus steppe traditions remains disputed.
